name: skyhook-plugin
description: Universal Project Intelligence for AI Agents

slash_commands.name: skyhook-question
slash_commands.description: Generate contextual questions to fill missing knowledge

slash_commands.name: skyhook-standards
slash_commands.description: List applicable standards for this project

slash_commands.name: skyhook-decide
slash_commands.description: Record an architectural or design decision
slash_commands.instruction: Run `skyhook decide` or use JSON: `echo '{"command":"recordDecision", "args":{"title":"...", "decision":"...", "context":"..."}}' | skyhook-cmd`

slash_commands.name: skyhook-sync
slash_commands.description: Sync code with documentation and check for drift

slash_commands.name: skyhook-profile
slash_commands.description: Show profile details (tech stack, variants, questions)

slash_commands.name: skyhook-batch-create
slash_commands.description: Bulk create features, stories, or requirements

slash_commands.name: skyhook-list-features
slash_commands.description: List all current features in the project

slash_commands.name: skyhook-get-blockers
slash_commands.description: List all blocked tasks and features

slash_commands.name: skyhook-update-status
slash_commands.description: Update the status of a feature or task

slash_commands.name: skyhook-get-context
slash_commands.description: Retrieve the full project context and background

slash_commands.name: skyhook-add-feature
slash_commands.description: Add a new feature to the backlog

slash_commands.name: skyhook-trace
slash_commands.description: Trace a requirement's implementation in code

slash_commands.name: skyhook-impact
slash_commands.description: Analyze impact of changing a requirement

slash_commands.name: skyhook-untraced
slash_commands.description: Find all requirements that have not been traced

slash_commands.name: skyhook-dashboard
slash_commands.instruction: Run `skyhook-cmd dashboard start` in the terminal.
